sloka: अब्रवीत् जनको राजा कौसल्य आनंद वर्धनम् ।इयम् सीता मम सुता सह धर्म चरी तव ॥१-७३-२६॥
transliteration: abravīt janako rājā kausalya ānaṁda vardhanam ।iyam sītā mama sutā saha dharma carī tava ॥1-73-26॥

translations.english: Thereafter king Janaka brought Sita adorned with various ornaments and placed her in the presence of Agni in front of Rama, the enhancer of the joy of Kausalya. And said:
